authentic Greek restaurant Pacific Beach San Diego

rows: Bar & happy hour menu only; catering menu is a PDF
site_compare.source: Agent audit 2026-10-23; Café Athena schema and llms.txt confirmed by the teammate's audit

trends: Happy hour drew the most related searches of any term tested in San Diego. People search it by restaurant name (Yard House, Javier's, Oggi's: Breakout) and want the menu.
La Jolla, Little Italy and North Park appear in happy-hour searches; Pacific Beach does not, so it's unclaimed.
Mediterranean searches are led by restaurant names (Aladdin, Sahara: Breakout). Greek searches are citywide ('greek restaurant san diego'), not 'Pacific Beach'.
'best restaurants pacific beach' and 'pacific beach restaurants on the water' are the key local phrases.
conflicts: Happy hour days: the bar menu says 'every day 3–6 PM', one home-page sentence says 'weekday'.
Fri–Sat closing: the official site says 9:30 PM; the San Diego Reader listing still says 10 PM. The teammate's check found no conflicts across 2 sources; this third listing differs.
Menu readability: the teammate's audit found no prices in HTML; the bar & happy hour page does list prices as text. The catering menu is PDF-only.
Maximum party size isn't published anywhere official.
